content:
camila: Heads-up — all-hands in 10m. Quick logistic change: moving the lightning updates to after the leadership Q&A so we can give extra time for roadmap questions. @maya ok? :eyes:
ben: ok from infra side. will confirm encoder health now.
oliver: I'm monitoring OBS in room C, CPU spiking at 85% on the streamer host. might drop frames if we keep long demos.
sara: AV team: we can switch to the low-latency config and mute local preview to save CPU. is that acceptable? :thumbsup:
camila: yes go ahead with low-latency. also small ask — please enable captions for the Q&A. last time captions lagged.
ben: looking at the encoder logs — seeing occasional "frame drops: 42" over the last 5m, and ffmpeg restarted automatically once. grabbing fallback command now.
allhands-bot: [STREAM] Live stream scheduled at 2025-11-04T17:00:00Z. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/20251104.mp4
ben: fallback ffmpeg command I'll use if OBS crashes:
```
ffmpeg -re -f x11grab -s 1920x1080 -i :0.0 -r 30 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 3500k -f flv rtmp://backup.example/streamkey
```
ben: switching to backup rtmp now if frame drops exceed threshold. will shout when done.
oliver: do that. also can AV mute the on-stage room mics to avoid the echo loop when we swap encoders?
sara: yep muting stage aux channel. pinging stage tech to set gain to -6dB.
camila: maya — we'll start with leadership update + Q&A, then lightning demos, then the product AMA. Any high-priority topics you want called out?
maya: sounds good. please flag any demo teams that need more time in the chat. also prepared to call out the new Dedicated capacity SLA improvements.
camila: noted. demo teams who need extra time, reply here.
ben: backup rtmp engaged, monitoring. so far frame drops stopped after switch. :relieved:
oliver: OBS restart done on streamer-03, studio cams rejoined, captions service reconnected.
sara: captions note: we're using live transcription v2 in low-latency mode, expect ~3s lag. turning on post-roll buffer to avoid missing last words.
camila: perfect. one more: recording artifact from last all-hands — gap at 42:10 — can we add a local iso recording as redundancy?
b en: (typo) ben: adding local iso to the NFS mount now, file path /mnt/iso/allhands-20251104-isovideo.mkv
ben: done. starting local iso recorder.
camila: great — thanks team. I'll open the Q&A doc now and share the link in 5.
allhands-bot: [REMINDER] Please join 5 minutes early if you are a panelist.
camila: panelists joining room-B for mics in 7. everyone else, join the stream link in the invite. see you shortly. :sparkles:
ben: last check: OBS framerate set to 30, encoder bitrate 3500k, captions on, local iso recording active. green across the board.
camila: merging into the stage now — thanks!
(End of thread)
